query: SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN price > (SELECT AVG(price) FROM products WHERE category = 'electronics' AND ref_id IN (SELECT ref_id FROM categories WHERE cat_nm = 'Computers & Accessories')) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) AS percentage_above_avg FROM products WHERE category = 'electronics' AND ref_id IN (SELECT ref_id FROM categories WHERE cat_nm = 'Computers & Accessories') AND price > 0
